ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region spanning from the peduncle to the median notch is solid low-intensity black. Extensive high-intensity white patches occupy the lateral sections of both lobes, containing heavy dark mottling and speckling, particularly along the leading edges and toward the tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 70-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 8% of total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge with peak amplitudes reaching 2-3% of fluke height; extreme jaggedness and pixel-level irregularity observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve trailing from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes, with a prominent convex leading edge sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast clusters (white rings on black background, or dark circles on white background) scattered across the central dark region and the right lobe's white patch, indicating barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, intersecting the white pigmentation patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring consisting of circular rosette marks and linear rake-like abrasions distributed across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of dark pixel speckling near the upper leading edge of the left lobe.
